shelters.name: IndyHumane
shelters.description: Serving Indianapolis since 1905. Leading voice for animal welfare, serves 18,000+ animals annually with 96% live release rate. First choice for shelter cats and dogs adoption, foster, behavior training, and affordable spay/neuter.

shelters.name: Humane Society for Hamilton County
shelters.description: The only open admission, truly no-kill animal shelter in Indiana. Believes every animal deserves a chance to live regardless of age, breed, or special needs.

shelters.name: Humane Indiana
shelters.description: Finds homes for cats and dogs and offers resources to help families keep pets healthy. Valparaiso center rescues, heals, and releases injured wildlife while educating about coexistence.

shelters.name: Humane Fort Wayne
shelters.description: No-kill, nonprofit shelter serving Northeast Indiana for more than 65 years. Hub for pets and people providing comprehensive, lifesaving resources and spay/neuter clinic.

shelters.name: Fort Wayne Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Best Friends Animal Society partner serving community in humane, public safety capacity. Keeps pets with loving families through education and resources.

shelters.name: Humane Society of St. Joseph County
shelters.description: One of Indiana's oldest service organizations, incorporated in 1896. Operates as area's largest animal care facility with over 2,700 animals annually.

shelters.name: Vanderburgh Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides animal rescue with veterinary services and finds forever homes for homeless animals in Evansville and surrounding area.

shelters.name: Humane Society of the Dunes
shelters.description: Dedicated to rescue of abused, abandoned, sick, and injured animals and their rehabilitation. Serves Northwest Indiana.

shelters.name: Brown County Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal shelter offering pet adoption, volunteer opportunities, and spay/neuter services.

shelters.name: Bartholomew County Humane Society
shelters.description: Serves entire county surrounding Columbus with adoptable dogs and cats, lost pet services, volunteering, and donations.

shelters.name: Almost Home Humane Society
shelters.description: Formed as Tippecanoe County Humane Association in 1939. Serves more than 3,000 pets each year through programs for the Greater Lafayette area.

shelters.name: Animal Protection League
shelters.description: Anderson's only open-admission shelter. Since April 2011, partnered with City of Anderson to manage shelter operations.

shelters.name: Madison County Humane Society
shelters.description: Takes in abused, neglected or homeless animals in or around Madison County. Running 100% on donations.

shelters.name: Muncie Animal Care and Services
shelters.description: Established 2016, proud No-Kill animal shelter and control department. Provides services to City of Muncie and Unincorporated Delaware County.

shelters.name: ARF - Animal Rescue Fund Muncie
shelters.description: Mission to promote promise to love and protect dogs and cats by providing shelter, nourishment, medical care and placement.

shelters.name: Bloomington Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Division of Department of Public Works. In 2024, foster families took 56% of animals, providing socialization and training to over 1,800 animals.

shelters.name: Clay County Humane Society
shelters.description: Proudly served Clay County, Indiana community since 1957.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Hobart
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) charity founded and receiving charter in 1954. Serves Northwest Indiana with animal rescue and adoption.

shelters.name: Pet Refuge
shelters.description: Charity organization serving the South Bend area with animal rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: Silverstray - Silver Lining Gary
shelters.description: Transforms communities through creating culture of caring. Provides critical services to underserved pet families in Gary including free spay/neuter, microchips, vaccines, and TNR.

shelters.name: Another Chance For Animals
shelters.description: Rescues and rehomes abandoned and neglected pets, providing medical care, fostering, and adoption services while promoting spaying and neutering.

shelters.name: Action for Animals
shelters.description: Cat rescue with adoptable cats at PetSmart in Muncie. All animals spay/neutered, vaccinated and microchipped.

shelters.name: LDOFW - Lost Dogs of Fort Wayne
shelters.description: Nonprofit assisting in locating and reuniting lost dogs with owners through community network, awareness campaigns, and search assistance.

shelters.name: Dog It Dig It Rescue
shelters.description: Licensed 501(c)(3) charity rescuing dogs at risk of euthanasia and giving them another chance at finding forever homes.

shelters.name: Indiana Humane Society
shelters.description: Statewide humane society serving multiple counties across Indiana with animal welfare services.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Indiana animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. IndyHumane has served Indianapolis since 1905 with 96% live release rate. Humane Society of St. Joseph County is one of Indiana's oldest (incorporated 1896). Humane Society for Hamilton County is the only open admission, truly no-kill shelter in the state. Coverage spans Indianapolis, Fort Wayne, Evansville, South Bend, Gary, Lafayette, Bloomington, Muncie, Anderson, and Columbus.
